requirement: Apply an update-antibiotic-group command to an existing model: copy the name, description, and parent ID (including clearing it for a root group), refresh UpdatedAt, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The target model is tracked but not yet saved

inputs.text: Command that reparents the group under a new parent ID
Command that promotes the group to a root group with a null parent ID

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with no error
Name and description overwritten with the command values
Parent ID replaced; a null command parent clears the stored parent
UpdatedAt is refreshed by every mapping

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
